# Compile N Run

> > A free, browser-based platform for learning programming languages and computer science fundamentals through interactive coding.

Compile N Run provides beginner-friendly documentation and hands-on coding environments for 10+ programming languages including Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, and Rust. The platform covers both language fundamentals and core CS concepts like algorithms, databases, networking, and operating systems, making it ideal for aspiring developers and interview preparation.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Java
- JavaScript
- C++
- C
- TypeScript
- SQL
- Algorithms
- Databases
- Operating Systems
- Networks
- Web Development
- Interview Preparation
- Object-Oriented Programming
- Memory Management

## Programming Languages

- [Python Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/python): Python language introduction covering history, features and basics
- [Java Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/java): Java programming language overview with history and OOP features
- [JavaScript Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/javascript): JavaScript fundamentals for web development with React and basics
- [C Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/c): C language fundamentals: history, UNIX influence and low-level memory
- [C++ Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/cpp): C++ programming basics covering history and object-oriented features
- [TypeScript Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/typescript): TypeScript setup and introduction to static typing superset of JS
- [C# Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/c-sharp): C# programming with .NET, .NET Framework and .NET Core setup
- [Rust Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/rust): Rust systems programming language with memory safety focus
- [Go Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/go): Go (Golang) language introduction by Google with basic syntax
- [Kotlin Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/kotlin): Kotlin JVM language for Android development by JetBrains
- [PHP Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/php): PHP server-side scripting for web development basics

## Databases & Data Management

- [Introduction to Databases](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/database): Database fundamentals covering MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and more
- [SQL Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/sql): SQL fundamentals for MySQL, PostgreSQL and database communication

## Computer Science Fundamentals

- [Algorithm Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/algorithm): Beginner-friendly introduction to algorithms and computational efficiency
- [Operating System Fundamentals](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/os): Operating systems concepts: Windows, Linux, macOS and resource management
- [Networks Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/network): Learn computer networks basics, components, topologies and protocols

## Frameworks & Platforms

- [.NET Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/framework/dotnet): .NET framework guide covering C#, F# and Visual Basic setup

## Career & Interview Preparation

- [Interview Types](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/interview): Guide to technical interview types and preparation strategies

## Getting Started

- [Compile N Run](https://www.compilenrun.com): Free platform to learn Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, C and more
